answers.text: Moderate coffee intake contributed fluid comparably to water in a study of habitual male coffee drinkers. Hydra counts the full volume of coffee and tea and applies no caffeine penalty. That study does not establish a safe caffeine amount for everyone.

evidence.title: Killer et al., 2014: coffee and fluid balance
